# posting kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:feedPostingKind`](gmeow-feedPostingKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/feedPostingKind>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of a posting — a value from the open [`gmeow:FeedPostingKind`](../classes/gmeow-FeedPostingKind.md) vocabulary (social, blog, microblog, …). Drives the schema projection (a social posting → [schema:SocialMediaPosting](https://schema.org/SocialMediaPosting), a blog posting → [schema:BlogPosting](https://schema.org/BlogPosting)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to set a posting's flavour to one [`gmeow:FeedPostingKind`](../classes/gmeow-FeedPostingKind.md) value; functional, so each posting carries exactly one flavour driving its schema projection.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting two flavours on one posting (it is functional) and avoid using it for content type of an arbitrary work — its domain is [`gmeow:FeedPosting`](../classes/gmeow-FeedPosting.md) alone.

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:FeedPosting`](../classes/gmeow-FeedPosting.md) at one [`gmeow:FeedPostingKind`](../classes/gmeow-FeedPostingKind.md) individual; the projection compiler reads it to choose [schema:SocialMediaPosting](https://schema.org/SocialMediaPosting) vs [schema:BlogPosting.](https://schema.org/BlogPosting.)
